label: FREE TOOL
headline: Tally: Simple, unlimited online forms
body: Collect customer feedback or sign-ups without limits. Build a custom form for your next workshop registration in minutes.
caption:
Need to gather information without hassle? Tally lets you create beautiful forms easily, often with features other tools charge for. It’s a great way to build simple surveys, order forms, or sign-up pages. Remember to check their website for the most current free plan details and any usage limits. Happy form building! 😊
